images.prompt:
Create exactly ONE portrait image, 1024x1536: Keeper H1 NW standing rest frame. Image 1 is the APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER: preserve ONLY its character identity, early-20s young woman, sun-browned skin, tied-back dark curly hair, costume, proportions, colours and hand-drawn painted register. Image 2 is GEOMETRY ONLY: use ONLY its NW body turn and item sides; do not take its hair, proportions, colours, texture or drawing style.
Turn the Image 1 woman 135 degrees from S into NW, BACK three-quarter view, facing viewer's upper-left away from the camera. Her BACK and near anatomical LEFT side are visible. Head level and turned away; no visible face except at most cheek edge and ear. Preserve Image 1's tied-back curly updo, not Image 2's voluminous ponytail. Standing rest, weight even, relaxed arms, not stepping. Fixed elevated three-quarter pinhole camera approximately 53 degrees above ground; character rotates, camera does not. Full body, both feet fully visible, centered, same standing height and framing as Image 1.
ANATOMICAL PLACEMENT: ONE olive canvas satchel with brass corners at near LEFT hip on SCREEN-LEFT, nearest camera. ONE chestnut strap crosses BACK diagonally from far RIGHT shoulder at screen-right down to left hip satchel. ONE plain dark walnut staff with small brass ferrules only at tip and foot held upright in anatomical RIGHT hand on FAR side, SCREEN-RIGHT behind her; tip above far shoulder. No mirroring. No staff rings or head-piece. Ivory linen shirt, rolled sleeves; navy sleeveless tabard with completely PLAIN back and chest; same short tabard length as Image 1, not elongated coat tails from Image 2; one waist belt with brass buckle, chestnut laced bracers, navy trousers, chestnut buckled boots. No emblems, insignia, extra straps, extra objects or text.
STYLE: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game. Confident dark contour drawn by hand with visible taper and varying weight; painted fills in clean planes within the line; restrained surface texture; readable silhouette; the line carries the pose. Looks like one frame of hand-drawn animation. Match Image 1's simplified material planes and contour, avoid Image 2's rendered illustration finish or intricate texturing. Blue / ivory / brass palette.
LIGHT: single cold key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT fixed to screen, slight rim along key-facing screen-left silhouette edge. Deep cool low-value ambient with readable shadows never pure black. No warm light, spell glow or floor shadow.
PLATE: flat uniform pure #00ff00 covers entire background. No floor, gradient, checkerboard, transparency, shadow or scenery. Deliver a single portrait rest frame, not a sheet; no matting or registration.
